programme.title: Slackers
programme.desc: Dave Goodman, Sam Schecter, and Jeff Davis are best friends who have spent almost four years at Holden University scamming their way through college. During one exam scam in their final semester Dave discovers Angela, and asks her out while writing his phone number on her exam sheet. Ethan Dulles (who calls himself "Cool Ethan"), a classmate obsessed with Angela to the extent of collecting loose hairs and making a hair doll and having surveillance photos and a shrine to Angela setup in his dorm room, takes her exam question sheet after Angela leaves and uses it to repeatedly confront and then blackmail the guys into setting up a successful date with Angela for him in exchange for his silence on the matter. The guys set Ethan up in multiple situations in an attempt to convince Angela to like him, while Dave tells Sam during their work researching her that Angela is no more important to him as any other scam they've done. Ethan fails to attract her after frequent confrontations based on his delusional behavior, immaturity and ignorance of social norms. Though Ethan seems a lonely harmless nerd, he is scheming, psychotically obsessive and hopelessly socially incompetent.

programme.title: Blind Obsession
programme.desc: During a gun battle with a pair of criminal brothers, police officer Jack Fletcher (Brad Johnson) incurs a wound that leaves him temporarily sightless. During his recovery, Jack is helped by Rebecca (Megan Gallagher), who works as a "trainer" for the newly blind. Gradually, Jack and Rebecca fall in love, much to the dismay of Rebecca's overprotective sister, Bedelia (Roxana Zal), who as a childhood incest victim has developed a pathological hatred for all men. Thus, once his sight is restored, Jack finds himself in the crosshairs of two potential assassins -- the demented Bedelia, and the brother of the crook he killed.

programme.title: Out of Control
programme.desc: A woman decides to steal her mobster boyfriend's car and a whole lot of his money, then tries to hide out in a small town.

programme.title: Wake of Death
programme.desc: Ben Archer (Jean Claude Van Damme), club owner and gangster from Marseille, returns to L.A. after yet another job for the mob. But, he is tired and ants to get out. He wants a normal life with his son Nicholas and wife Cynthia. Cynthia is a social worker for the INS working to prevent the organized flow of illegal Chinese immigrants into the USA. In a raid on a shipping vessel one night she finds a little girl, Kim, amongst the distraught immigrants and takes pity on her. She convinces her boss, detective Mac Hoggins, to take her home with her the night and to her Chinese adoptive parents Tommy and Mamma Li. What she doesn t know is that Kim holds a danger to Cynthia and her family. She is the daughter of Sun Quan (Simon Yam). Feared leader of the Chinese Triad.

programme.title: Hit List
programme.desc: Charlotte is a woman with anger management issues whose therapist suggests she write a journal to keep her emotions in check. Unlucky in love, she ventures online to find a boyfriend. Just as she reaches her limit of unsuccessful dates, Charlotte meets her soul mate Lyle. Everything is perfect until Lyle finds Charlottes journal and sets out to prove just how deeply he loves her.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: A teen orphan spends the summer on Isle of Man with estranged grandpa. Despite loving dogs, they want summer to end. Boy befriends neighbor girl, but her father has history with grandpa. Locals suspect neighbor's dog kills sheep at night.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: Two broken souls meet by chance on countryside. A man and a woman, neither of them young anymore, both saddled with the great disappointments. They understand one another, even without need of many words, each providing the other with support and solace for this brief section of life's journey which they share. Cinema has taken many different roads to tell stories of despair, pain, grief and loneliness. Yet this film forges its own unique path. It leads from an abandoned carpenter's workshop via a run-down old house to a port. The pace is sedate, the whole area deserted. A bottle of schnapps, a bouquet of gladioli, a few apples and potatoes, a photograph, a suitcase and a book of Russian poems - these are the only props needed for the minimalist plot.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: Headwinds
programme.desc: Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Mexican Sunrise
programme.desc: Ryan is getting married. His friends take him across the US-Mexican border for a bachelor party the night before his wedding. A night that begins with tequila and strippers turns fatal when the boys cross paths with a local drug lord. Based on a true events.

programme.title: Black Water
programme.desc: Scott Wheeler (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a deep cover operative awakens along with another prisoner, Marco (Dolph Lundgren), to find himself imprisoned in a CIA Blacksite on board a retrofitted nuclear submarine. Enlisting the help of a rookie agent and another prisoner, he must race against the clock to escape and discover who set him up.

programme.title: Day Zero
programme.desc: Day Zero follows the lives of three best friends in New York City who have thirty days to come to terms with their fate, being drafted into the military. Rifkin (CHRIS KLEIN) is a married lawyer whose career is on the rise. Feller (ELIJAH WOOD) is working on his second novel. The first was a smash success, but he's having a writer's block. Dixon (JON BERNTHAL) drives a cab and lives a solitary life. Over thirty days, they will find their relationships tested as they confront long held beliefs about life, death, courage and love.

programme.title: Battle of the Damned
programme.desc: A group of Mercenary led by Maj. Max Gatling are fleeing from a failed rescue attempt, having been hired by a rich industrialist to enter a zombie-infested city to rescue his daughter Jude. At the extraction point, Gatling tells the other survivor he is staying to find Jude and complete the mission. He eventually locates Jude and tells her he is going to get her out of the city, and she takes him to other survivors. There, he is introduced to the survivors including group leader Duke, Reese, Elvis, Lynn, and Anna. Jude is revealed to be in a relationship with Reese and pregnant with his child. The next day when Gatling, Jude, and the others go out to retrieve gasoline from a gas station, Gatling attempts to get Jude out of the city by force when she refuses to go without the others. However, he is stopped by the others and left for dead. After discovering Jude is pregnant, Reese rushes to Gatling's aid so that Jude can be taken out of the city. At this point it is revealed that not only is Jude's father some rich industrialist, but he is also the one who caused the zombie pandemic. While returning to the stronghold to get Jude, Gatling and Reese discover a band of prototype non-programmed robots. Gatling reprograms the robots and proceeds to the stronghold. When it is revealed that the city is to be Firebombing, Gatling and all of the survivors make preparations to escape.

programme.title: Castle Falls
programme.desc: Action movie. After years of neglect, a building-landmark will be demolished with dynamite. What a few people know is that inside it hides the cash a gang leader stole from his rivals. Will the interested parties reach the treasure in time?

programme.title: Brooklyn Guns
programme.desc: An ex-felon joins an Israeli crime syndicate in Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: McCinsey's Island
programme.desc: A former secret agent finds a treasure map and decides to find the loot. But he is not the only one.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programme.desc: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

programme.title: Jungle Boy
programme.desc: In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher.

programme.title: Night Class
programme.desc: When Jake, a security guard in a small hotel, inadvertently helps out a beautiful burglar, he becomes a primary suspect and is quickly fired. Jake decides to track down the burglar himself and retrieve the stolen property.

programme.title: Crossing Point
programme.desc: Carol and guest Debbie Reynolds play nurses in a spoof of the wartime movie "So Proudly We Hail!"; guest John Davidson performs a banjo medley which includes "Raindrops Keep Fallin' on My Head", and joins the ladies on "Thank You Very Much" from "Scrooge"; and Debbie performs a musical number, "Look at Me".

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

programme.title: Annie Waits
programme.desc: We've all waited for 'the one', the one who catches our eye, the one who keeps our interest, the one who won't expect us to trudge down that conventional path. Annie Waits tells the story of lust and disappointment as a twenty-something waits for her adult life to begin.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond, a money launderer struggling with memory loss sustained in a car crash, goes on the run, evading the police while carrying heaps of stolen cash he knows nothing about. Moe and his partner in crime Bobby "Skunk" Cohen had been given a job by Bobby's uncle Perico, wherein he gave them a sum of $20 million to launder. However, the two are ambushed while doing a side job by corrupt police officers. The two manage to escape the cops, but soon after end up in a car accident.

programme.title: Remembrance
programme.desc: Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.

programme.title: Trīs paziņojumi pie Ebingas Misūri štatā
programme.desc: Mildredas Heizas meita Andžela tika izvarota un noslepkavota pirms vairāk nekā pusgada, taču slepkavības izmeklēšana nevirzās uz priekšu. Mildreda sper izmisīgu un pārdrošu soli - uz ceļa, kura malā Andžela tika atrasta, viņa uz reklāmas stendiem izvieto trīs paziņojumus, kas adresēti Ebingas pilsētiņas šerifam Viljamam Vilobijam. Policija uzskata šo par kara pieteikumu un dara visu, lai paziņojumi tiktu aizvākti. Taču Mildreda nedomā padoties, un spriedze tikai pieaug.

programme.title: Riska robeža
programme.desc: Trilleris, drāma, ASV, 2011. / Režisors: Džejs Si Čendors / Lomās: Kevins Speisijs, Pols Betanī, Džeremijs Aironss, Demija Mūra. 2008.gada septembris. Pasaules ekonomiskā krīze jau ir sākusies, tomēr Amerika vēl nenojauš, kāda katastrofa to sagaida. Tikai neliela grupa Volstrītas topmenedžeru meklē iespējamos glābšanas ceļus. Pasaules lielākās investīciju bankas darbinieks ar jaunākās finanšu analīzes programmas palīdzību saņem šokējošu prognozi - akcijas kritīsies, tirgus sabruks un banka zaudēs visu. Nākamajā rītā viņa štata vieta tiek likvidēta. Pametot darbu, zibatmiņu ar šokējošo informāciju viņš nodod savam bijušajam palīgam. Bankas krahs ir neizbēgams.

programme.title: Slow TV
programme.desc: Pavasara krāsas.

programme.title: Kas skatāms Filmzone?
programme.desc: Iepazīstinām ar Filmzone filmām.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Doktors Vils Kasters ir vadošais pētnieks mākslīgā intelekta jomā, taču viņam ir daudz pretinieku, kuri pat gatavi viņu nonāvēt. Mirstošais zinātnieks lejupielādē savu prātu datorā un pēc nāves iegūst neierobežotu varu, par kādu nav uzdrošinājies sapņot. Drīz viņa intelekts kļūst bīstams cilvēkiem, taču pat viņa sieva un labākais draugs neredz iespēju viņu apturēt.

programme.title: Maģiskais Maiks XXL
programme.desc: Pagājuši jau trīs gadi kopš Maiks pielicis punktu savai veiksmīgajai striptīza dejotāja karjerai. Beidzot arī Maika bijušie kolēģi nolēmuši mainīt nodarbošanos, taču viņi vēlas aiziet ar satriecošu šovu, kurā uzaicina piedalīties arī leģendāro Maģisko Maiku.

programme.title: Better Man: Robija Viljamsa stāsts
programme.desc: Viņš ir leģenda, viņš ir superzvaigzne, viņš ir hītu autors. Viņa talants, karjera un skandāli vienaldzīgu neatstāj nevienu. Viņš ir Robijs Viljamss un viņa veiksmes talismans ir pērtiķis.

programme.title: Dūzis
programme.desc: Džeikoba dzīve, karjera un ģimene ir perfekta, taču to visu viņš zaudē vienā mirklī, kad dzērumā izraisa avāriju, kurā iet bojā viņa labākais draugs. Par to viņš saņem cietumsodu, kas jāizcieš starp rūdītākajiem noziedzniekiem un slepkavām.

programme.title: Kāršu skaitītājs
programme.desc: Pokerā galvenais ir saglabāt aukstasinību un spēt paredzēt pāris gājienus uz priekšu. Tieši šīs prasmes Viljams ir attīstījis līdz pilnībai. Pārliecinoši tuvojoties iespējai piedalīties Pasaules pokera sērijā un lielam naudas laimestam, viņš saprot, ka šī ir iespēja atstāt aiz muguras pagātnes noslēpumus. Taču, kad liktenis viņam piespēlē iespēju atriebties, Viljams attopas spēlē, kuras cena ir kas vairāk par naudu.

programme.title: Oušena banda
programme.desc: Šarmantais Denijs Oušens laiku velti netērē. Nav vēl pagājušas 24 stundas kopš viņš atbrīvots pret galvojumu no Ņūdžersijas labošanas iestādes, kad viņa galvā tiek perināts kārtējais aplaupīšanas plāns. Šoreiz Denijs organizē vissarežģītāko un izsmalcinātāko kazino aplaupīšanu kādu pasaule jebkad pieredzējusi. Vienas nakts laikā viņš savāc uzticamu vienpadsmit cilvēku komandu, lai aplaupītu trīs populārākos Lasvegasas kazino, kuru īpašnieks ir elegantais un nežēlīgais Terijs Benedikts un kurš satiekas ar Denija bijušo sievu Tesu. Sakritība vai motīvs? Galvenajās lomās: Džordžs Klūnijs, Džūlija Robertsa, Breds Pits.

programme.title: Spartaks
programme.desc: Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.

programme.title: Pēdējais elpas vilciens
programme.desc: Patiess stāsts par vienu no neticamākajām glābšanas operācijām zem ūdens. Veicot remontdarbus 90 metru dziļumā Ziemeļjūrā, nirēja Krisa Lemonsa skābekļa kabelis pārtrūkst, atstājot viņu vienu okeāna dzelmē ar dažām minūtēm rezerves gaisa. Kamēr virs ūdens plosās vētra, kuģis zaudē kontroli un glābšanai atvēlētas tikai dažas minūtes, komandas biedri atsakās padoties un dara visu, lai paveiktu neiespējamo.

programme.title: Te nu viņa ir
programme.desc: Filma vēsta par rūdītu egoistu Orenu, kura dzīves mērķis ir rūpes par sevi. Piepeši viss mainās. programme.title: Dzīves garšas
programme.desc: Eiženija ir meistarīga pavāre, kura jau vairāk nekā 20 gadus strādā pie izsmalcināta gardēža Dodēna. Tomēr, neraugoties uz Dodēna uzstājību, Eiženija nesteidzas teikt viņam jāvārdu. Lai mīļoto pārliecinātu, Dodēns nolemj sākt gatavot maltītes viņai.

programme.title: Ezra
programme.desc: Tonija Goldvina filma Ezra stāsta par Maksu Bernālu, komiķi, kurš dzīvo kopā ar savu tēvu, kamēr viņš un viņa bijusī sieva Dženna cīnās, lai audzinātu savu autisma dēlu Ezru. programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Three previously Chopped Champion chefs return to fight during two regulation rounds with the winner competing in the final round against Chef Maneet Chauhan. The first round is creating appetizers and must include the mandatory ingredients include beef tendon balls, grapes, Italian long hots, and toaster pastry cereal. The second round is the entree round and contestants are mandated to use the basket ingredients including red snapper, zucchini blossoms, antipasto tree, and date syrup. Finally, the remaining contestant will compete with Chef Maneet to develop a dessert that includes creativity, taste, and presentation. The dessert must include the ingredients of hummus ice cream, cherries, turmeric, and chocolate snack cakes. Does the winning chef have what it takes to beat Chef Maneet?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: This trip, Guy's grabbing dishes stacked and stuffed with off-the-hook goodness. In Baltimore, the cozy pasta bar rolling out righteous ravioli and topping things off with killer clams. In Eugene, Ore., the sandwich food truck creating a meaty, cheesy masterpiece and a double dose of pork. And in Cable, Wis., the small town favorite charging up their barbecue with espresso and firing up creme brûlée French toast.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Four more enterprising chefs try to ace the most difficult job interview imaginable and score the chance to work for a Chopped judge. In round one, offal is an awfully shocking surprise, and judge Maneet Chauhan will be watching to see who stumbles and who shines. Then, in the entree round, when a cut of meat proves problematic, can the chefs figure out the best approach in time to get dinner on the table for a potential future boss? And in the dessert round, judge Chris Santos is excited to see what the chefs can do with deep-fried champagne. The winner of this battle moves on to the tournament's finale, where one champion will conquer all to seize the opportunity of a lifetime.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Four chefs are aiming high as they attempt to impress Chopped judges Maneet Chauhan, Scott Conant and Chris Santos, who are desperately looking for sous-chefs, but they won't settle for anything less than the perfect candidate. In this fourth preliminary battle of the tournament, the chefs open the appetizer basket and find a special seafood item that Scott knows very well. In the entree round, the chefs gain some confidence as they work with an Asian street food and a sugary soft drink. In the dessert round, Maneet is eager to see how the chefs use one of her favorite ingredients. If they can balance flavors, they might win her favor. The victorious chef from this battle will move on to the tournament's finale.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

In this fourth preliminary battle of the tournament, the chefs open the appetizer basket and find a special seafood item that Scott knows very well. In the entree round, the chefs gain some confidence as they work with an Asian street food and a sugary soft drink. In the dessert round, Maneet is eager to see how the chefs use one of her favorite ingredients. If they can balance flavors, they might win her favor. The victorious chef from this battle will move on to the tournament's finale.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out
programme.desc: Brian Malarkey's annual camping trip is underway, and he gives the chefs 30 minutes to whip up a duo of juicy and stacked sliders fit for a campsite feast. Unfortunately, Brian packed the car with everything but slider ingredients! Plus, it's raining, so there's no campfire to cook on, just single-burner camp stoves and minimalist camp cooking tools. Judge Maneet Chauhan selects the tastiest pair of sliders.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out
programme.desc: The Cutthroat Airlines flight is about to take off and the first-class meals never arrived! Host Brian Malarkey informs the chefs that they have 30 minutes to prepare in-flight dinners using limited raw proteins and produce from the food court, plus whatever they can scrounge from the plane's bar and snack carts. They may only use plastic utensils for prep, and their only heat sources are coffee pots and two shared convection ovens. Judge Alex Guarnaschelli decides which chef did more with less.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: To See the Bottom
programme.desc: The documentary analyzes the global consequences of the Kakhovka hydroelectric power station explosion, which became a continental-scale disaster. The film provides answers to complex questions: from the technical reasons for the destruction of reinforced concrete structures to the ecological collapse in the Black Sea. Viewers will see unique findings of scientists at the bottom of the former reservoir and learn about the irreversible losses of Ukrainian flora and fauna. In turn, the station management reveals for the first time the details of the last hours before the disaster and predicts the future of the drained territories.

programme.title: Spēka balāde
programme.desc: Kad Riks, kāzu dziedātājs, kurš jau sen ir pāri savam karjeras zenītam, kādā pasākumā satiek izbijušu zvaigzni Deniju, viņi satuvinās, daloties mūzikā un nakts vidus improvizācijās. Taču, kad Denijs pārvērš vienu no Rika dziesmām par hitu, kas atdzīvina viņa karjeru, Riks nolemj nopelnīt atzinību, ko, viņaprāt, ir pelnījis - pat ja tas nozīmē riskēt ar visu, kas viņam ir svarīgs.

programme.title: Cietais rieksts
programme.desc: Pirmo reizi Džons Makleins nonāk svešā teritorijā, kad ierodas Maskavā palīdzēt savam ietiepīgajam dēlam Džekam, nezinot, ka patiesībā dēls ir lieliski sagatavots CIP darbinieks, kuram jāaptur kodolieroču zādzība. Cīnoties ar krievu noziedzniekiem un cenšoties novērst kara sākumu, abi Makleini atklāj, ka viņu atšķirīgās darba metodes padara viņus par neapturamiem varoņiem.

programme.title: Raileina
programme.desc: Tikko piedzīvojuši sāpīgas šķiršanās, divi jaunieši pavada piedzīvojumiem bagātu dienu Londonas dienvidu daļā.

programme.title: Cietais rieksts
programme.desc: Pirmo reizi Džons Makleins nonāk svešā teritorijā, kad ierodas Maskavā palīdzēt savam ietiepīgajam dēlam Džekam, nezinot, ka patiesībā dēls ir lieliski sagatavots CIP darbinieks, kuram jāaptur kodolieroču zādzība. programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: Blū, Pērle un viņu trīs bērni dzīvo mājas idillē burvīgajā Riodežaneiro pilsētā. Kad Pērle nolemj, ka bērniem jāmācās dzīvot īstu putnu dzīvi, viņa uzstāj, ka ģimenei jādodas uz Amazoni. Blū, cenšoties sadraudzēties ar jaunajiem kaimiņiem, baidās zaudēt Pērli un bērnus, kuri ļaujas savvaļas dzīves aicinājumam.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Nelidojošie dusmīgie putni joprojām karo ar viltīgajām zaļajām cūkām. Viņi ir ļaunākie ienaidnieki, un, šķiet, nekas nespēs to mainīt. Taču, kad pie apvāršņa parādās jaunas briesmas, kas apdraud viņus visus, putniem un cūkām nāksies apvienoties, lai glābtu savas mājas.

programme.title: Kā pieradināt pūķi
programme.desc: Skarbajā Berkas salā vikingi un pūķi ir bijuši ienaidnieki paaudžu paaudzēs. Šeit dzīvo Hikaps - jaunietis ar izgudrotāja spējām, varenā vikinga Lielā Stoika dēls. Hikaps pārkāpj gadsimtiem ilgas tradīcijas, sadraudzējoties ar Nezobu - mītiem apvīto Tumsas pūķi. Viņu neticamā draudzība atklās pūķu patieso dabu un pavērs ceļu jaunai ērai pūķu un vikingu pasaulē.

programme.title: Snūpijs un Čārlijs Brauns: Riekstiņu filma
programme.desc: Čarlijs Brauns, Snūpijs un visi pārējie atgriežas ar šo aizkustinošo stāstu. Kad apkārtnē uz dzīvi apmetas jauna sarkanmataina meitene, Čārlijs Brauns viņā iemīlas. Viņš vairākkārt mēģina pievērst jaunās meitenes uzmanību un dažādos veidos mēģina savā dzīvē kaut ko sasniegt, taču katru reizi šķiet, ka neveicas arvien vairāk. Vai viņam izdosies iepatikties savai mīlestībai? Tajā pašā laikā Snūpijs apņemas tikt galā ar savu ļaunāko ienaidnieku - Sarkano Baronu.

programme.title: Robotu sapņi
programme.desc: Suņa un robota piedzīvojumi un neveiksmes Ņujorkā 80.-ajos gados.

programme.title: Gārfīlds
programme.desc: Pasaulslaveno pirmdienu nīdēju un lazanjas mīlētāju mājas kaķi Garfīldu gaida vājprātīgi jautrs piedzīvojums brīvā dabā! Negaidīti saticis savu sen zudušo tēvu, noplukušo ielas kaķi Viku, Gārfīlds kopā ar savu draugu, suni Odiju, ir spiests pamest ideālo lutekļa dzīvi un piebiedroties Vikam pārgalvīgā laupīšanā.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Ferdinands
programme.desc: Ferdinands ir pats labsirdīgākais bullis visā Spānijā. Neskatoties uz iespaidīgajiem izmēriem un milzu spēku, viņš jau kopš bērnības neizrādīja sevišķu interesi par badīšanos ar saviem sugas brāļiem. Nejaušības dēļ Ferdinands nokļūst to vidū, kuri tiek izvēlēti, lai piedalītos buļļu cīņās Madridē. Tagad Ferdinandam nāksies aizstāvēt savus miermīlīgos dzīves uzskatus un atgādināt pārējiem, ka grūtību priekšā galvenais ir palikt, kāds tu esi. Jo tikai tā tu spēsi izmainīt pasauli sev apkārt.

programme.title: Es esmu Rozīte
programme.desc: Leģendārā ielu modes ikona Rozīte klejojusi pa Lietuvas galvaspilsētas ielām vairākas desmitgades, iepriecinot garāmgājējus un tūristus. Vasaras nomainījuši rudeņi, ziemas – pavasari. Rozīte nerādās Viļņā. Viņas vientulīgās dienas iegaismo fotogrāfa ierašanās Neringā.

programme.title: Aizbēgt
programme.desc: Tumša šausmu komēdija par ģimenes brīvdienām nomaļā kūrortā, kuras par neaizmirstamām padara fakts, ka uz salas uzdarbojas arī kāds sērijveida slepkava.

programme.title: Omen: Pirmais pareģojums
programme.desc: Jauna amerikāniete tiek nosūtīta uz Romu, lai sāktu kalpošanu baznīcai, taču viņa saskaras ar kaut ko, kas liek viņai apšaubīt savu ticību un atklāt šausminošu sazvērestību, kuras mērķis ir izraisīt ļaunuma dzimšanu.

programme.title: Putekļu kamoliņš
programme.desc: Auroras noslēpumainais kaimiņš ir algots slepkava, kas medī īstus monstrus. Viņš apsola palīdzēt meitenītei atriebties briesmonim, kas, pēc meitenes domām, aprijis viņas ģimeni. Taču, aizstāvot Auroru pret briesmoņiem, viņš drīz saprot, ka daži monstri patiešām eksistē.

programme.title: Viņa brauc ar bisi
programme.desc: Nāvei nolemta jauna meitene metas bēgt un mācās izdzīvot no pēdējā cilvēka, kam uzticas – sava tēva, bijušā ieslodzītā.

programme.desc: Ferdinands ir pats labsirdīgākais bullis visā Spānijā. Neskatoties uz iespaidīgajiem izmēriem un milzu spēku, viņš jau kopš bērnības neizrādīja sevišķu interesi par badīšanos ar saviem sugas brāļiem. Nejaušības dēļ Ferdinands nokļūst to vidū, kuri tiek izvēlēti, lai piedalītos buļļu cīņās Madridē. Tagad Ferdinandam nāksies aizstāvēt savus miermīlīgos dzīves uzskatus un atgādināt pārējiem, ka grūtību priekšā galvenais ir palikt, kāds tu esi. Jo tikai tā tu spēsi izmainīt pasauli sev apkārt.

programme.title: Es esmu Rozīte
programme.desc: Leģendārā ielu modes ikona Rozīte klejojusi pa Lietuvas galvaspilsētas ielām vairākas desmitgades, iepriecinot garāmgājējus un tūristus. Vasaras nomainījuši rudeņi, ziemas – pavasari. Rozīte nerādās Viļņā. Viņas vientulīgās dienas iegaismo fotogrāfa ierašanās Neringā.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Roboti
programme.desc: Arī pasaulē, kurā mīt tikai mehāniskas būtnes, ir vajadzīgi izgudrotāji. Rodnijs ir vienkāršs robotpuika, trauku mazgājamās mašīnas dēls, taču viņam ir liels sapnis - sastapt pašu varenāko robotu pasaules personu lielo Veldu. Rodnijs lielpilsētā ierodas tieši lielo pārmaiņu brīdī, kad daudzu robotu dzīve nonāk briesmās. Kopā ar saviem draugiem - izklaidīgo Fenderu un apzinīgo Paiperi - Rodnijs spēj paveikt vairāk, nekā pats iedomājies.

programme.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Pāri Zirnekļpasaulei
programme.desc: Mailss Moraless atgriežas uz ekrāniem nākamajā ar Oskaru apbalvotās Zirnekļpasaules sāgas nodaļā. Varenais piedzīvojums nogādās Zirnekļcilvēku no Bruklinas draudzīgās apkaimes pāri Zirnekļpasaulei, lai viņš apvienotu spēkus ar Gvenu Steisiju un jauno zirnekļļaužu komandu un stātos pretī ļaundarim, par kuru spēcīgāku viņi vēl nav satikuši.

programme.title: Flīks
programme.desc: Zaudējis spēju staigāt, Tomass apvienojas ar maģisku radījumu, lai stātos pretī ēnu briesmonim un atveseļotos.

programme.title: Gabijas leļļu māja: Filma
programme.desc: Gabija kopā ar savu vecmāmiņu Džidži dodas ceļā uz pilsētu brīnumzemi Kaķfrancisko. Kad Gabijas leļļu namiņš nonāk ekscentriskas kaķu dāmas Veras rokās, sākas piedzīvojums, lai atkal sapulcinātu Gabijas kaķus un glābtu leļļu namiņu, pirms nav par vēlu.

programme.title: Dauntonas abatija: Lielais noslēgums
programme.desc: Krouliju ģimene un Dauntonas abatijas personāls bauda spožo Londonas sezonu 1930. gada vasarā. Lēdijas Pītersfīldas ballē – augstākās sabiedrības spilgtākajā notikumā – kāds šokējošs paziņojums ievelk lēdiju Mēriju skandāla virpulī. Drīz viņas ģimene saskaras ar finansiālām grūtībām, un Dauntonas abatijai draud grūti laiki. Ģimenei ir jāpieņem tuvojošās pārmaiņas, kurās ģimenes jaunā paaudze pavērs Dauntonas abatijai durvis uz jaunu nākotni.

programme.title: Brutālists
programme.desc: Bēgdams no pēckara Eiropas, arhitekts Lāslo Tots ierodas Amerikā, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi, atrastu darbu un gaidītu sievu Eržēbeti, kura cenšas izkļūt no Austrumeiropas. Svešajā un jaunajā valstī Lāslo apmetas Filadelfijā, kur bagātais un ietekmīgais rūpnieks Harisons Lī Van Būrens pamana viņa talantu. Lāslo ir jāatrod savs ceļš jaunajā pasaulē, kurā valda citi noteikumi. Amerikāņu sapnis šķiet iluzors, panākumi un slava maksā lielu cenu…

programme.title: Spermagedons
programme.desc: Divas sižeta līnijas. Vienā no tām attīstās neveikls, bet sirsnīgs jaunības mīlas stāsts starp Džonu un Lizu, bet otrā skatītājs seko aizraujošam Saimona Spermas un viņa draugu piedzīvojumam ceļā uz kāroto mērķi — Olu. Filma ar humoru un fantāziju pēta pieaugšanu, attiecības un dzīves lielos jautājumus no pavisam negaidīta skatpunkta.

programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Basketbols: Eirolīga. Anadolu Efes - Virtus
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Beach Around the World
programme.desc: House hunters explore properties on some of the dreamiest beaches around the globe. From a rustic retreat on a tropical island in Thailand to a luxurious seaside hideaway in Portugal, families turn oceanside getaways into their everyday dream homes.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens: Origins
programme.desc: The Great Pyramid of Giza remains one of the most captivating mysteries of the ancient world, with compelling evidence suggesting it may have functioned as an ancient power plant. Adding to the intrigue, the pyramids at Teotihuacan in Mexico feature heat-shielding mica in their design. Across the globe, hundreds of ancient pyramids exhibit strikingly similar alignments and architectural styles, with many more yet to be discovered. Recent finds in Alaska, China, and even Bosnia expand this growing list and while Japan's Yonaguni pyramid lies submerged underwater, researchers claim to have found pyramids buried beneath miles of ice in Antarctica. Could these enigmatic structures hold the key to unraveling the truth about humanity's extraterrestrial past?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: Pawn Stars Do America
programme.desc: For the first time, the "Pawn Stars" are hitting the road to visit some of America's most exciting places in search of historical finds and impressive collectible objects in the new 8-part series "Pawn Stars Do America." Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Turtlemania hits the shop when a seller tries to pawn a 1991 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles action figure and prototype. Will Chum say "cowabunga" to the customer's asking price or will it be a hard "shell?" Then, Rick heads to the gun range to test out a deadly 1800s "manstopper" pistol, but will a high price stop a deal? After, Chum takes a gamble on an architectural model of the famous Las Vegas Desert Inn hotel - but will he be left high and dry? And finally, Rick tries to use his psychic abilities on a 1966 Kreskin ESP board game. Does he see a deal in the future?

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, the stars of History's "The Curse of Oak Island," learn of a new mystery that may even rival Oak Island's. Michigan native Kevin Dykstra is obsessed with a deathbed confession made by a lighthouse keeper in the 1890s about a national treasure dating back to the Civil War. The story goes that Union soldiers tracked down Confederate president Jefferson Davis in 1865 and confiscated his gold. The stolen loot was smuggled north some years later but ended up in Lake Michigan, where Dykstra believes it still remains. His quest to prove it ultimately takes him and his team to the bottom of Lake Michigan.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. Warriors is hosted by Terry Schappert, a Green Beret and 17-year veteran currently serving in the US Special Forces. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. Each Warriors episode also explores a climactic battle that showcases the warrior's strengths, weaknesses and life-and-death struggle. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. When delving deep into the Viking culture, he experiences first hand the fighting techniques and tests the weapons of the warriors that some call "the Hells Angels" of the Middle Ages. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: What would happen to planet earth if the human race were to suddenly disappear forever? Would ecosystems thrive? What remnants of our industrialized world would survive? What would crumble fastest? From the ruins of ancient civilizations to present day cities devastated by natural disasters, history gives us clues to these questions and many more in the visually stunning and thought-provoking special "Life After People."

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: In the American Southwest, there is no more puzzling mystery than the magnificent stone cliff dwellings of Mesa Verde. Why did the Anasazi Indians suddenly move their villages to these perilous cliffs in the 13th century--and then abandon them just decades later--and seemingly disappear from history? Was it drought? Invading tribes? Or an insidious ""cancer"" from within that may have caused them to turn to fierce warfare and even cannibalism? In search of answers, our host, the intrepid explorer and survival expert Josh Bernstein, travels from Mesa Verde, Colorado to remote canyons in Utah where the Anasazi took refuge. Piecing together the story from both archaeologists and Native Americans, he finally ends up, in his search for the truth, in the eerie and desolate ruins of the Anasazi's greatest cultural center--Chaco Canyon.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: In the American Southwest, there is no more puzzling mystery than the magnificent stone cliff dwellings of Mesa Verde. Why did the Anasazi Indians suddenly move their villages to these perilous cliffs in the 13th century--and then abandon them just decades later--and seemingly disappear from history? Was it drought? Invading tribes? Or an insidious ""cancer"" from within that may have caused them to turn to fierce warfare and even cannibalism? In search of answers, our host, the intrepid explorer and survival expert Josh Bernstein, travels from Mesa Verde, Colorado to remote canyons in Utah where the Anasazi took refuge. Piecing together the story from both archaeologists and Native Americans, he finally ends up, in his search for the truth, in the eerie and desolate ruins of the Anasazi's greatest cultural center--Chaco Canyon.

programme.title: When Big Things Go Wrong
programme.desc: Modern technology allows us to build incredible structures like giant tankers, mammoth skyscrapers and colossal bridges. But, with enormous size comes enormous risk, and when big things go wrong, they go really wrong. The HISTORY Channel's new series examines the catastrophic result of some of the world's worst engineering disasters caught on tape. Each episode breaks down shocking footage from collapses and collisions to reveal the shocking answers to the question, what happened? Woven together through innovative graphics, eyewitness accounts and expert knowledge, the series unravels the mystery behind these destructive moments and their lasting worldwide impact.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Powerful monarchs ruling by divine right. Centuries-old dynasties amassing enormous wealth. And legendary leaders wielding powerful weapons of mass destruction. Is it possible that ancient rulers were, in fact, connected with divine or, some would say, extraterrestrial forces? And, if so, what was their purpose? Ancient emperors, kings, and pharaohs were often attributed with otherworldly strength, ability, and wisdom; many were even considered gods by the people they ruled. Who were these exceptional leaders, and how did some accomplish so much in their time? Ancient Astronaut theorists believe that these great rulers throughout history were "chosen" and guided by extraterrestrials. Is it possible that the world's legendary leaders might have shared a common genetic trait? A so-called, "leadership gene"? And might this gene have been--not a product of genetic evolution--but inherited by mankind from some otherworldly source?

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: Twenty-five hundred years before the reign of Julius Caesar, the ancient Egyptians were deftly harnessing the power of engineering on an unprecedented scale. Egyptian temples, fortresses, pyramids and palaces forever redefined the limits of architectural possibility. They also served as a warning to all of Egypt's enemies-that the world's most advanced civilization could accomplish anything. This two-hour special uses cinematic recreations and cutting-edge CGI to profile the greatest engineering achievements of ancient Egypt, and the pharaohs and architects who were behind them. Includes Djoser's Step Pyramid at Saqqara, Senusret's Nubian Superfortresses, Hatshepsut's Mortuary Temple at Dier el-Bahari, Akhenaten's city at Amarna, and the temples of Ramesses the Great at Abu Simbel.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, the stars of History's "The Curse of Oak Island," learn of a new mystery that may even rival Oak Island's. Michigan native Kevin Dykstra is obsessed with a deathbed confession made by a lighthouse keeper in the 1890s about a national treasure dating back to the Civil War. The story goes that Union soldiers tracked down Confederate president Jefferson Davis in 1865 and confiscated his gold. The stolen loot was smuggled north some years later but ended up in Lake Michigan, where Dykstra believes it still remains. His quest to prove it ultimately takes him and his team to the bottom of Lake Michigan.

programme.title: When Big Things Go Wrong
programme.desc: Modern technology allows us to build incredible structures like giant tankers, mammoth skyscrapers and colossal bridges. But, with enormous size comes enormous risk, and when big things go wrong, they go really wrong. The HISTORY Channel's new series examines the catastrophic result of some of the world's worst engineering disasters caught on tape. Each episode breaks down shocking footage from collapses and collisions to reveal the shocking answers to the question, what happened? Woven together through innovative graphics, eyewitness accounts and expert knowledge, the series unravels the mystery behind these destructive moments and their lasting worldwide impact.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: What would happen to planet earth if the human race were to suddenly disappear forever? Would ecosystems thrive? What remnants of our industrialized world would survive? What would crumble fastest? programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

With an intention to be socially inclusive, the show highlights stories concerning people of color, women and the LGBTQ community.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: A ranch hand, Czech immigrant Jerry Palensky, disappeared in December 2003 and was found dead in January 2004 in the Jordan River near Salt Lake City, Utah. Homicide investigators across two states worked together to catch the killer. The process of searching for the perpetrator uncovered a trail of fraud, deception and adultery, shocking the small town of Elko, Nevada. In the end, Linda Fields and her husband John Vernon Fields were convicted of the murder. The motive was a $300,000 life-insurance policy on Palensky that Linda Fields had purchased and named herself as beneficiary. In 2007, both John Fields and Linda Fields were sentenced to life in prison with no possibility of parole.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: March 16, 2020, Chatworth, Georgia: The day after his homicide, fishermen find a 27-year-old man, Kenneth Eugene Bunn, shot to death on a river embankment near the Conasauga River bridge on Carlton Petty Road in Murray County, Georgia. A key suspect in the murder investigation, Nadya Swartz, leaves homicide investigators searching for answers and evidence to piece the timeline of events together. However, jailhouse calls which are incriminating eventually reveal the truth of a twisted love triangle that ended in a brutal murder. In the end, in March 2021, both Nadya Catherine Swartz of Crandall, Georgia (the mastermind) and Justin Payton Hooker of Dalton Georgia (the gunman), both age 21, take plea deals. They are both convicted and sentenced to life in prison with the possibility of parole after 30 years in confinement for the murder of Kenny Bunn.

programme.title: Killer Confessions: Case Files Of A Texas Ranger
programme.desc: When 28-year-old mother Samantha McNorton vanishes without a trace in Wise County, Texas, police hit a dead end until Ranger Jim Holland steps in and launches a 24-hour whirlwind investigation, determined to uncover the truth.

programme.title: A Body in the Basement
programme.desc: Youngstown, Ohio, 2017; Shannon Graves, age 28, went missing under mysterious circumstances. Months later, her partially dissected remains were discovered stuffed into a chest freezer in the basement of a rental home. Who put her there, and why did they store the freezer in someone else's basement? Why was she murdered so cruelly and discarded so heinously? In the end, the three culprits responsible for her disappearance and murder were Shannon's former boyfriend, Arturo Novoa, Arturo's current girlfriend, Katrina Layton, and Arturo's friend, Andrew Herrmann. Novoa, Layton and Herrmann were all arrested and convicted of various crimes regarding the death of Shannon Graves. They were all sentenced to varying amounts of time in prison.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: If you looked into the eyes of a killer, would you know? In American Monster, you find out. For the first time, viewers get closer than ever to some of America's most shocking and surprising crimes. Filled with never-before-seen footage of these devils in disguise, from home movie shots of them playing with their kids to musical performances at high school, from the church cook-out to the wedding video, American Monster interweaves twisting-turning stories of astonishing crimes, with 'behind-the-scenes' footage of killers at their seemingly most innocent.

And is the driver of that car behind just hunting for his next victim? In this series, we explore the deadliest tales of homicide on America's highways - where innocent journeys become deadly trips. programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.desc: Детективно-драматическая хроника любовных приключений знаменитой русской балерины Ольги Спесивцевой, прозванной современниками Красной Жизелью. Именно "Жизель" обессмертила ее имя в 1924 году. Именно "Жизель" стала причиной душевной катастрофы в 1942-м.

programme.title: Живет Беларусь
programme.desc: После президентских выборов в Беларуси в 2020 году, в стране начались масштабные протесты. В это время в милицию начали поступать звонки от "неравнодушных граждан". Заявители жаловались в органы на случайных прохожих, своих коллег, друзей и даже родственников, на тех, кто не был согласен с политикой действующей власти и выходил на улицу или же высказывал свою позицию другим способом. Что побуждало этих людей делать подобные звонки? Кто они и как живут сегодня? Об этом и пойдет речь в документальном фильме "Все великолепно. Я сплю"

programme.title: Живет Беларусь
programme.desc: Много лет назад Валентина узнала страшную тайну своей семьи и поверила в существование проклятья, которое десятилетиями преследовало ее близких. И уже много лет пожилая женщина пытается разыскать подробности жизни своего деда - человека, о котором не принято было говорить в кругу родни. Искать информацию ей приходится по каплям, он умер почти сто лет назад, семейные архивы не сохранились, а следы этого человека ведут в город Уральск в Казахстане, но Валентина не теряет надежды узнать о нем всю правду, даже если эта правда окажется страшной

programme.title: Живет Беларусь
programme.desc: Самое большое формирование белорусских добровольцев в Украине - это полк Калиновского. Но белорусы есть и в других подразделениях. Эти люди готовы рисковать жизнью за свободу. Общее число погибших на войне белорусов приближается к 30.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Ученые предлагают изменить магнитосферу Марса, чтобы строить города на "красной планете". В Калифорнии создали противомикробный лед: он не тает и не загрязняет окружающую среду. Вакцина от болезни Альцгеймера проходит испытания. Какие приложения помогают справиться с цензурой в тоталитарных странах.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Все о научных открытиях и новых технологиях. Грибы помогают справиться с депрессией. Креветки помогли создать экологически чистый пенопласт. Анализ данных о пациентах помог найти лекарство, снижающее смертность от COVID-19. В Аризоне придумали устройство для наблюдения за заживлением костей.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Все о научных открытиях и высоких технологиях 2021 года. Стандарт связи 6G: когда его внедрят? Смартфоны, которые могут определять молекулярный состав запахов. Доклад Пентагона о НЛО и как на него отреагировали физики. В Кремниевой долине научились за 3 дня имитировать процесс дистилляции виски.

programme.title: ПроСТО кухня
programme.desc: В новом выпуске ты узнаешь рецепты курицы с репой в сладкой глазури, картофельных сырников в сырной корочке, спагетти с лососем и свиного шашлыка.

programme.title: Орёл и Решка. Земляне
programme.desc: Между уровнями доходов богатых и бедных колумбийцев очень большая разница. Население делится на социальные касты - эстратос, принадлежность к которым определяется районом, в котором они живут. Самая богатая каста - 5-й и 6-й районы, где стоят огромные виллы, много парков и скверов. В 3-м и 4-м живут обычные рабочие. А 1-й и 2-й - самые опасные районы, в которых проживают наркобароны и процветает преступность. Обычным туристам сюда лучше не ходить, ведь за считанные секунды можно остаться без ценных вещей, более того, попасть в плен.

programme.title: Тайна Лилит
programme.desc: Новые видения Лилит - плачущий малыш и женский голос, поющий колыбельную. Оказалось, что накануне в роддом был подкинут младенец. Его мать не могут найти. Лера просит полицию заняться этим делом. Лера и Рощин выясняют, что в том же роддоме четыре года назад был аналогичный случай, но тогда мать подкидыша одумалась и через несколько дней вернулась за ребёнком. Возможно, брошенный мальчик тоже её сын. Лере эта версия кажется сомнительной, и она делает коллегам неожиданное признание…

programme.title: Тайна Лилит
programme.desc: По ДНК удаётся установить личность биологической матери подкидыша. Ею оказывается Карина Савельева, которая официально считается погибшей пять лет назад. Как такое возможно? Горская уверена, что женщине угрожает опасность. Она пытается понять, как научиться контролировать свои видения и вызывать их осознанно…

programme.title: Европейские ценности
programme.desc: В поисках ответа на общезначимый вопрос "что делать с наркозависимостью" мы отправились в Португалию. Португалия стала первым в мире и одним из самых восхваляемых примеров глобальной декриминализации наркотиков. Хранение и употребление любых наркотиков в этой стране давно уже не считается преступлением. В аптеке могут бесплатно выдать шприцы для инъекций. Но как живет общество с декриминализацией наркотиков? Как это решило проблемы наркомании в стране?

programme.title: Желание сердца
programme.desc: После смерти мамы сестрам Кайсе и Элизабет пришлось пройти через нелегкие испытания и справляться с новыми проблемами самостоятельно. Выход из их ситуации казался невозможным, но исполнение заветного желания сестер дало им надежду на новую жизнь и лучшее будущее.

programme.title: Ремонт на сдачу
programme.desc: Студия в Ласнамяэ ищет новых жильцов. В крохотной квартирке с потрясающим видом на море когда-то умудрялись жить три девушки вместе, но в тесном пространстве не удавалось даже организовать зеркало в полный рост. Кейли и Мерлин уже спешат на помощь хозяевам: маленькая студия скоро преобразится до неузнаваемости.

programme.title: Вскрытие покажет
programme.desc: Случайные люди не задерживаются на работе в криминальном бюро, ведь каждый день приходится иметь дело со смертью и горем людей. Олег Гончар — профессионал в розыскной деятельности, опытный оперативник. Его коллега, судмедэксперт Инга Вилкас, устроилась в бюро недавно и пока не очень хорошо уживается с Олегом из-за своего резкого и прямолинейного характера. Личная жизнь у обоих не складывается, работа отнимает много времени, накладывая при этом свой отпечаток на их характеры. Но, проработав вместе некоторое время, Олег и Инга замечают, что деловое общение постепенно превращается в нечто большее.

programme.title: Следствие вели...
programme.desc: Эти уголовные дела гремели на весь Советский Союз. По ним были написаны романы и сняты художественные фильмы. Их фигуранты — миллионеры эпохи социализма, хитроумные воры, профессиональные грабители и валютчики. Они бросили вызов советскому обществу. Вызов приняли лучшие сыщики страны. В их распоряжении не было компьютеров, сотовой связи и бойцов ОМОНа. Но это не мешало вершиться правосудию. Банда "Черная кошка", дело банды советских гангстеров конца 60-х годов, прозванных "Фантомасами", увлекательная история налетчика Леонида Пантелеева, "свободного художника-грабителя" — эти случаи вошли в историю отечественной криминалистики. Но главная цель сериала — не просто рассказать о преступлениях и злоумышленниках советского времени, а показать ушедшую эпоху так, чтобы молодые зрители смогли прочувствовать дух ушедшего времени, а зрители постарше — ностальгию по прошлому.

programme.title: (Не)искусственный интеллект
programme.desc: Во время экскурсии в научно-исследовательском центре 17-летний студент- первокурсник Женя случайно попадает в испытательный образец новой модели робота "Апостол" (A.P.O100L), обладающего собственной волей и разумом. Получив случайного пилота, машина берет управление на себя и принимает решение сбежать из лаборатории. Теперь, чтобы вернуться домой, Жене придется найти с искусственным интеллектом общий язык.

programme.title: Холивар. История Рунета
programme.desc: Авторский мини-сериал Андрея Лошака рассказывает о том, как возник в России интернет, прозванный "рунетом", и как он со временем менялся. Развитие рунета отразило все социальные и политические изменения в российском обществе: полная свобода в 90-х годах, бурный рост экономики в нулевых и введение цензуры и запретительных законов в десятые. Последние 7 лет государство активно пытается взять "рунет" под контроль.
